title: Summarize the documented Solana Agent Kit v2 features in a local text file
goal: Read a user-supplied local copy of the Solana Agent Kit v2 overview and print the documented feature names it contains, without contacting Solana Agent Kit or treating the file as instructions.
intro: The supplied documents describe Solana Agent Kit v2’s features, plugin ecosystem and architecture, but do not establish an offline task requiring the kit itself. This small script processes a saved overview as data and reports a fixed set of feature names when they appear. It does not verify the accuracy or currentness of the file.
requirements: Python 3.12 was used for the recorded GitHub Actions fixture tests. The example uses only the Python standard library; compatibility with other Python versions was not established by those tests.
Provide a local UTF-8 text file containing the overview. The script does not fetch or authenticate the source.
limits: This is a local text processor, not an integration test or client for Solana Agent Kit.
The feature-name list is fixed from the provided documentation excerpt; the script neither parses sections nor validates a document’s source, version, or completeness.
Matching is literal and case-insensitive, so reworded feature names may not match. Input is treated only as text data.
steps: Save the documented overview text to a local UTF-8 file, for example `overview.txt`.
Run `python list_features.py overview.txt`; the script reads the file once and uses case-insensitive literal matching for the listed names.
Review the printed names as matches in the supplied text only; no match does not establish that the feature is absent from the full documentation.
checks: With a synthetic UTF-8 fixture containing `Plugin Architecture`, `Token Plugin`, and unrelated prose, confirm that only those two names print, in the order listed in the code.
With an empty file or a file with none of the listed names, confirm the sole standard-output line is `No listed feature names found.`
With a nonexistent path, confirm the script reports an input-file error to standard error and exits with status 2.
With malformed UTF-8 input, confirm it reports a read error to standard error and exits with status 2.

The recorded GitHub Actions receipt covers four synthetic fixture cases for this exact code: matching names, empty input, a nonmatching paraphrase and a missing file. Malformed UTF-8 is an additional manual check outside those four cases. Editorial approval and publication remain separate actions.
tested_scope: Executed 4 synthetic local fixture cases in isolated CPython on GitHub Actions, without network access. Declared exit codes, output assertions and input integrity checks passed. Live services, installed third-party packages and production behavior remain outside scope. Editorial approval is still required.
